eos.reference: Converted from CoolProp Nitrogen (identical Helmholtz coefficients).

viscosity.reference: Exact conversion of CoolProp Nitrogen viscosity (published coefficients; max rel err 2.2e-16).

conductivity.reference: Exact conversion of CoolProp Nitrogen conductivity (published coefficients; supercritical max rel err 1.7e-08; near-critical Olchowy-Sengers deviates up to 6.8e-03).
